baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 1, 2, 4, 14, and 18-19 link utterance, communal address, hearing, guidance, and a straight route.
baseline_models.mechanism: Understanding enters through hearing, is externalized as speech to a people, and becomes movement toward a rectified route. Reception and relay are stages of one social mechanism.

activation_trace.role: The spoken-utterance sense externalizes what was received and makes relay publicly inspectable.
The people-group sense supplies the social recipient, so the report is communal rather than private.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes reception actionable rather than merely acoustic.
Gentle direction toward truth and a route gives the heard book its operative force.
The extended-way sense turns guidance into a course that can be entered and followed.
Rectitude and evenness qualify the course produced by receptive hearing and relay.

changed_reading.before: A group reports that it heard a book and states where the book leads.
changed_reading.after: The utterance is a relay event: receptive hearing generates public speech to a people and summons them into a traversable, rectified course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 5-13 place a descended book after Moses while making it confirm what stands before it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Temporal succession is coupled to joining, connection, and realization. The later book does not gain identity by severing the prior word; it binds itself to that word and makes its standing claim effective.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies a material model for a book that binds messages into a corpus.
The after-versus-before relation establishes succession without itself requiring rupture.
Realizing a word or promise makes confirmation active fulfillment rather than passive resemblance.
A connection maintained between sides makes the prior material relationally present to the later book.
The before-the-hands idiom places prior material in the book's active foreground rather than a discarded past.

changed_reading.before: The book comes later than Moses and agrees with an earlier scripture.
changed_reading.after: Laterness and confirmation form a continuity mechanism: the new corpus joins, keeps present, and realizes a prior word instead of deriving authority from replacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 14-19 repeat the directional construction toward truth and toward a straight route.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired destinations can remain differentiated: stable reality is the orientation, while the extended and rectified route is the procedure by which that orientation is sustained.

activation_trace.role: Direction, manner, and intent make guidance an orientation that can govern continued conduct.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the destination against which the route is measured.
An extended way supplies the procedural medium rather than another abstract synonym for truth.
Evenness and rectitude specify the route's maintained quality.

changed_reading.before: Truth and straight path are two near-synonymous objects of guidance.
changed_reading.after: The book gives both an orientation toward stable reality and the rectified procedure for moving toward it; destination and route coexist without collapsing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same focus root occurs in the communal address at word 2 and in the route's straightness at word 19.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root links audience and outcome. A people is not only told about a straight path; the address calls that collective to rise into and maintain the path's own rectitude.

activation_trace.role: The people-group branch supplies the collective material addressed by the report.
Rising with resolve toward an undertaking turns communal identity into mobilization.
Rectitude supplies the form into which the addressed collective is implicitly called.

changed_reading.before: Our people merely names the audience, while straight merely qualifies the path.
changed_reading.after: The root repetition makes the address reflexive: the people themselves are called to stand up into the route's ordered straightness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening identifies the book's descent from God under might and wisdom. Read back into the focus passive descent, succession after Moses becomes deliberate delivery of an ordered and binding corpus, not accidental chronology.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery anchors the focus book as something conveyed into the listeners' domain.
A written determination that establishes judgment makes the focus book potentially normative as well as textual.
Delivery from above supplies the explicit originating motion that the focus passive leaves unnamed.
Binding determination gives the descended book ordered authority rather than the status of a free report.
Firm workmanship and exact ordering connect divine wisdom to the book's authoritative placement.

structural_cues: The opening nominal chain joins descent, book, divine source, might, and wisdom before any controversy begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine provenance and ordered wisdom; I infer that provenance gives the later book authoritative placement. The live alternative is that the opening establishes source without changing the focus's temporal relation to Moses.

changed_reading.before: A book happened to be sent sometime after Moses.
changed_reading.after: The book is deliberately delivered into a post-Mosaic position as an ordered, consequential determination.

context_deltas.mechanism: A surviving trace, close following, knowledgeable witness, likeness, and renewed confirmation turn continuity into an inspectable chain. The focus claim does not merely assert agreement; it invites comparison across marks, tracks, testimony, and corresponding books.

activation_trace.role: A written object gives the continuity claim a stable item that can be compared rather than only remembered.
Making a prior word effective supplies the verifying action at the center of the evidence chain.
A remaining mark that indicates what preceded supplies material evidence for claims about an earlier book.
Tracing step after step makes fidelity to revelation procedural rather than a vague appeal to tradition.
Testimony grounded in knowledge externalizes correspondence as evidence another observer can state.
Likeness supplies the comparative relation by which the later and earlier witnesses can be tested together.
The repeated realizing-confirmation sense closes the chain by explicitly linking the Mosaic book and the present book.

structural_cues: The challenge in 46:4 asks for an earlier book or a remaining trace of knowledge.
46:9-12 move through following revelation, witness to a likeness, the Mosaic book as precedent, and the present book as confirming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered evidence vocabulary; I infer that these items form one comparative chain that sharpens the focus confirmation. The live alternative is that each item answers a separate controversy without prescribing a single test.

changed_reading.before: Confirming means that the later book broadly agrees with an earlier one.
changed_reading.after: Confirming is an evidentiary operation: surviving marks are followed, corresponding testimony is heard, and two textual witnesses are compared for realized continuity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deniers make social precedence a test of goodness and, after failing to accept guidance, call the message ancient falsehood. The focus reverses that temporal polemic: being after Moses and confirming what preceded becomes support, not disqualification.

activation_trace.role: Explicit after-versus-before ordering gives the focus the temporal material that the polemic tries to devalue.
Firm completion lets inherited age count as established continuity rather than stale residue.
Competitive precedence exposes the social assumption that truth should arrive through the already dominant group.
Failure to accept direction explains the later dismissal and separates reception from chronological age.
Ancientness supplies the dismissive label that the focus converts into corroborating precedence.

structural_cues: The conditional claim about goodness and being preceded is followed by failure to be guided and a charge of ancient falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing uses of precedence and age; I infer a deliberate reversal when the focus treats prior revelation as confirmation. The live alternative is that social precedence and scriptural precedence are unrelated objections.

changed_reading.before: After Moses simply dates the heard book.
changed_reading.after: The dating carries a polemical reversal: priorness can corroborate truth, while social lateness cannot invalidate it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spoken confession is followed by sustained standing. This turns the focus straight route from an external map into a condition enacted after speech by people who keep themselves aligned.

activation_trace.role: Rectitude supplies the focus route's quality and the state that can be embodied.
The extended course gives rectitude duration and practical movement.
Speech as professed belief makes the opening declaration a committed orientation rather than bare sound.
Rising with resolve to an undertaking turns confession into sustained action.
The explicit rectitude sense identifies the enacted state with the focus route's defining quality.

structural_cues: The sequential particle places sustained uprightness after the spoken confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies declaration followed by upright persistence; I infer that the focus path names a lived state as well as teaching. The live alternative is that the path remains wholly objective while 46:13 separately describes its followers.

changed_reading.before: The straight path is correct information located outside the hearer.
changed_reading.after: The straight path is also enacted persistence: declared belief must become a maintained collective posture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same fore-hands construction appears inside a sequence of warners who have passed, with what is behind explicitly added. This animates the focus prior material as a procession extending through positions, not a static object left in the past.

activation_trace.role: A maintained connection between positions lets prior revelation remain active within a moving sequence.
The fore-position places prior material ahead and near enough to guide the later witness.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the repeated function moving through the sequence.
Generations passing through time gives motion to the witnesses surrounding the present warner.
The repeated connection between positions directly links the procession to the focus wording.
The repeated fore-position supplies the front of the temporal and spatial field.
One thing coming after another and taking its place extends the field beyond a single predecessor.

structural_cues: The repeated fore-hands construction is paired with an explicit behind-position and with warners who have passed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, passage, front, and behind; I infer a moving chain of warning that reanimates the focus's prior corpus. The live alternative is that both constructions are conventional idioms referring only to earlier figures or texts.

changed_reading.before: What stands before the book is a static label for earlier scripture.
changed_reading.after: What stands before it belongs to a moving fore-and-aft procession of witnesses in which the later book now takes position.

context_deltas.mechanism: A phenomenon approaches from a direction, faces the valleys, and is read as desired rain before being disclosed as punishment. This spatial misreading activates the focus guidance as correction not only of destination but of how an incoming sign is faced and interpreted.

activation_trace.role: Direction and manner make guidance relevant to how an approaching sign is oriented and read.
An extended route provides the spatial frame within which correct or mistaken orientation has consequences.
Something appearing from a direction supplies the ambiguous object that must be interpreted.
Face-to-face encounter makes reception an active orientation rather than passive visibility.
A valley as a channel for flow supplies a route-like receiver toward which the phenomenon moves.
Expected benefit in the form of rain exposes the desire that governs the first, mistaken reading.

structural_cues: The first demonstrative identification is immediately overturned by a corrective particle and a contrary disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, facing, channel, desired rain, and reversal; I infer an analogy to receiving descended discourse. The live alternative is that the weather scene has no interpretive bearing on the focus route beyond a general warning.

changed_reading.before: Guidance identifies the correct destination after the message is already recognized.
changed_reading.after: Guidance also retrains reception itself, correcting how what comes from ahead is classified before the hearer commits to a route.

context_deltas.mechanism: Another people possessed hearing, sight, and hearts, yet those faculties did not avail them because they knowingly denied the signs. The focus first-person hearing therefore becomes contrastive evidence of effective uptake, not proof of mere exposure.

activation_trace.role: Auditory perception supplies the minimal event that both receptive and unreceptive groups can share.
Understanding and compliance distinguish the focus listeners from those whose ears yield no benefit.
The effective-understanding branch is activated precisely where possessed hearing is declared useless, exposing missing uptake.
Inner discernment shows that sensory possession must become perceptive judgment.
The inwardly kindled heart supplies the integrating faculty that failed to convert sensation into response.
Sufficiency and avail name the failed function, separating ownership of faculties from useful operation.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the blockage that makes otherwise intact senses ineffective.

structural_cues: Hearing, sights, and hearts are first listed as endowments and then repeated under a negation of all benefit.
The failure is temporally linked to denial of the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies identical sensory capacity with opposite outcomes; I infer that the focus plural hearing marks receptive uptake because it immediately produces recognition and relay. The live alternative is that the focus verb reports only the acoustic event and the response must be inferred from later speech.

changed_reading.before: We heard reports sensory access to the recitation.
changed_reading.after: We heard is a compressed moral contrast: sound crossed into understanding, recognition, and action instead of stopping at an endowed but useless faculty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Diversified signs seek return; a band is then redirected to the recitation, listens in disciplined silence, waits for completion, turns to its people, and warns. The focus speech is the portable result of a full circulation protocol in which listeners themselves become the route by which the book travels.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance make the focus report the successful middle stage of circulation.
The people-group sense supplies the destination to which the received warning is carried.
Turning signs through different forms supplies the general rerouting operation aimed at return.
Return supplies the intended result that the later listeners enact socially.
Redirecting from one face or course places the band on the encounter route.
Attentive understanding converts redirection into uptake rather than accidental proximity.
Receptive silence supplies the disciplined condition under which the group can hear as one.
Completion creates the boundary after which reception properly becomes onward speech.
Turning away supplies the physical transition from attendance to return toward the people.
Warning that awakens caution names the new public function acquired by the listeners.

structural_cues: The paired temporal clauses order attendance, commanded silence, completion, turning, return, and warning.
The redirection root in 46:27 recurs when the band is directed to the recitation in 46:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered movements and repeated turning root; I infer a causal circulation protocol in which reception produces mobile warners. The live alternative is that the sequence is descriptive chronology and the focus only summarizes its content.

changed_reading.before: The focus records what the listeners said after hearing.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the transportable payload of a rerouting cycle: signs turn listeners, listeners turn toward their people, and heard guidance becomes renewed warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus route becomes a call-and-response relation with legal and social consequences. Answering the caller moves one from deviation into protected nearness; refusing leaves one unable to escape and without protecting allies.

activation_trace.role: The traversable route supplies the spatial frame for movement out of error and into protection.
Rectitude supplies the just aim against which deviation is exposed.
A verbal answer turns guidance from one-way information into a reciprocal summons.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the initiating relation to which the people must respond.
Deviation from a just aim supplies the negative directional state opposed to the straight route.
Protected proximity under a pledge makes the route's consequence asylum rather than orientation alone.
Failure to outrun pursuit closes the imagined escape route available to nonresponders.
Protective alliance supplies the social shelter explicitly absent outside the response relation.
Loss of the intended course names the exposed condition on the other side of the straight path.

structural_cues: 46:31 issues plural imperatives to answer and trust, followed by forgiveness and protection.
46:32 mirrors the call with nonresponse, inability to escape, absent allies, and manifest error.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, answer, shelter, failed escape, and absent allies; I infer a transfer from directional error into protected relation. The live alternative is that forgiveness and protection are later rewards, not constituent stages of walking the path.

changed_reading.before: The book guides by transmitting correct propositions about truth.
changed_reading.after: The book's route is also relational: it calls for an answer that relocates the hearer from deviation and exposed isolation into protected nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus offers truth through hearing and guidance; the later scene confronts deniers with a demonstrative question, extracts verbal acknowledgment, and commands experiential tasting. Hearing becomes an earlier mode of recognition that can precede compelled encounter with consequences.

activation_trace.role: Understanding through hearing supplies the voluntary epistemic mode available in the focus.
Stable reality names what can first be received as guidance and later confronted as undeniable.
Negation that challenges present denial frames truth as an immediately demonstrable state.
The repeated stable-reality sense identifies the final object with the focus destination.
Spoken question, acknowledgment, and verdict make delayed recognition publicly explicit.
Experiential testing replaces mediated hearing with direct consequence.

structural_cues: A demonstrative question about truth is answered affirmatively and immediately followed by an imperative of tasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hearing, later acknowledgment, and experiential tasting; I infer a temporal contrast between voluntary recognition and compelled experience. The live alternative is that the sensory verbs are locally rhetorical and do not form an epistemic sequence.

changed_reading.before: Truth is only the abstract destination named by the book.
changed_reading.after: Truth is hearable before it becomes unavoidable experience; the focus records the receptive mode that can recognize it before consequences make it demonstrative.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command joins restraint, the resolve of messengers, refusal to hasten, and a duration later perceived as brief. The focus route is therefore straight not because it is quick, but because its direction is held through delay.

activation_trace.role: The extended course supplies the duration across which direction must be maintained.
Rectitude names constancy of alignment rather than speed of arrival.
Restraint of the self from panic supplies the temporal discipline needed to stay aligned.
Holding an intended course and proceeding on it directly activates the focus route as resolved movement.
Speed and premature advancement supply the explicitly blocked alternative to steady progress.
Delay and slowness make elapsed duration perceptible without turning it into deviation.

structural_cues: The command to persist is modeled on resolute messengers and paired with a prohibition on haste.
The eventual day contracts the perceived interval to only a brief stay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, course-holding resolve, anti-haste, and compressed hindsight; I infer that straightness includes temporal fidelity. The live alternative is that these are instructions to the messenger and do not alter the focus audience's route image.

changed_reading.before: A straight route suggests the shortest or quickest line to a destination.
changed_reading.after: Its straightness is temporal fidelity: direction remains fixed through delay, restraint, and the refusal to force the promised end.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a rare bodily branch of the repeated focus root rather than its ordinary rectitude branch. It remains anchored in the focus hearing and straightness roots and in 46:26's explicitly useless senses; render it only as a diagnostic analogy, not as a lexical gloss of the route adjective.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins effective hearing at word 4 to the repeated people/straightness root at words 2 and 19.

activation_trace.role: An eye that remains structurally standing after sight is lost supplies a counter-image of intact form without function.
Effective understanding supplies the living function that prevents straightness from becoming empty appearance.
Inner sight makes perceptive function, not organ possession, the relevant contrast.
Failure to avail supplies the explicit test by which intact outward equipment is exposed as inert.

changed_reading.before: Straightness can be read as correct outward form alone.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory counter-reading, a community or route may look upright yet remain perceptually inert; genuine straightness must function through receptive understanding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain material activation: the named dune landscape is not a lexical definition of the focus path. It remains valid because the packet supplies both the straight-route anchor and an explicitly bent, curved terrain within the warning sequence; downstream prose should mark it as a spatial analogy about maintained bearing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 18-19 present an extended route qualified by rectitude.

activation_trace.role: The extended way supplies the traversed line whose bearing can be maintained across difficult terrain.
Rectitude supplies directional integrity rather than a claim that the surrounding terrain is geometrically flat.
Bending and deviation supply the contrasting geometry through which a true bearing must be held.
A curved sand ridge materializes a landscape where straight guidance cannot mean an effortless visible line.
A valley channel adds constrained and bending terrain to the route analogy.

changed_reading.before: A straight path is imagined as an uncomplicated straight line in a compliant landscape.
changed_reading.after: The path can be a maintained true bearing through curved dunes and channels; environmental crookedness makes guidance necessary rather than impossible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the focus guidance root, so it is deliberately form-distant. Explicit destruction and the failure of false supports keep the activation visible, but downstream prose must present dismantling as a secondary material echo, never as the direct lexical sense of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 14 directs toward truth and an extended straight route, leaving obstructions to that route as a live functional question.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply the split-root image that guidance may clear structures blocking the route.
The extended route anchors demolition as clearance for movement rather than free-standing destruction.
Root-and-branch destruction activates the material force of dismantling while also warning against making it the whole reading.
Failed aid from adopted supports identifies the structures whose removal can clear allegiance and direction.

changed_reading.before: Guidance only points around existing structures toward a route.
changed_reading.after: In a contained split-root echo, guidance can also dismantle false supports that obstruct entry into the route it indicates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading activates the non-dominant mapped root attached to the focus speech root, so carrying is not offered as the verb's lexical replacement. It remains anchored because the speech follows completed listening and the listeners turn toward their people; render it as a material image for transmission only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 1 begins the public utterance, while words 4-5 identify what the speakers have received and now relay.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and setting out supplies a split-root image in which speech bears the received book into another social space.
A joined corpus supplies the coherent payload that the utterance can carry.
Completion of the listening event releases the received material for onward transmission.
Turning away from the completed recitation supplies the outward movement toward the new audience.

changed_reading.before: Their saying is only a verbal report about a book.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material echo, the saying itself lifts and carries the joined message from the listening assembly into the speakers' community.

strongest_changes: Hearing changed from sensory exposure into effective uptake that necessarily produces relay.
Confirmation changed from generic agreement into an inspectable continuity chain in which priorness supports rather than discredits truth.
The straight route changed from an external map into enacted collective uprightness, maintained direction, and responsive movement.
The post-focus call changed guidance into a social and protective relation that moves the responder out of deviation and exposed isolation.
Truth changed from an abstract endpoint into something hearable now and, if refused, demonstratively experienced later.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses an unusually kinetic mechanism: a descended and continuity-bearing corpus is heard effectively, carried by redirected listeners to their people, and converted into a call whose route is epistemic, social, spatial, and temporal at once. Distinct readings remain live rather than being merged into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The evidence-chain and circulation models infer causal unity from ordered packet cues that could also answer separate local controversies.
The fore-and-aft procession, approaching-cloud, curved-dune, and protected-route readings are spatial or social analogies rather than mandatory lexical readings.
The non-dominant mapped-root activations for speech-bearing and guidance-as-dismantling are deliberately form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The distinction between truth as destination and straight route as procedure is plausible but the paired constructions may still function as rhetorical near-synonyms.
